metadata.description: Execution SOPs and creative heuristic skills for engineering, distributed systems, research, software discovery, frontend work, and visual design. Checklist records SOP execution; heuristics remain open-ended.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Eight execution SOPs for requirements, feedback, testing, delivery, maintenance, defensive review, authorised security investigation, and operations; two creative lenses for architecture and code representations; one router. SOPs use checklist 0.5+. Exploration has no gates.

plugins.name: distributed
plugins.description: Holdfast is a creative lens for causality, partial knowledge, coordination, and alternative distributed-system designs. Thought experiments and institutional analogies open possibilities; no mandatory stages or checklist runtime.

plugins.name: inquiry
plugins.description: Prospect and crucible generate research questions and mechanisms. After a direction is selected, ledger, forge, reckoning, and envoy provide SOPs for experimental planning, traceable execution, bounded analysis, and communication. No mandatory pipeline; submission requires separate permission.

plugins.name: quarry
plugins.description: Two SOPs: forage captures a bounded, dated shortlist; touchstone evaluates a selected project for a stated use through source, maintenance, compatibility, and trial evidence. The touchstone skill is independent of the inactive root A/B experiment platform.

plugins.name: surface
plugins.description: Creative lenses bearings, wellspring, and livery explore journeys, state models, and visual directions. SOPs keel, seaworthy, trials, lookout, and bulwark implement and maintain selected work. Pilot routes to either kind or a direct answer; ordinary CSS questions do not require a workflow.

plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Seven peer creative lenses: canon, color, type, layout, form, graphics, and motion. Systems is an SOP for implementing a selected direction as tokens and components. Pilot is the router. Canon is not a universal prerequisite; design probes are optional instruments, not taste certificates.
